name: cursor-follow-trail
title: Cursor Follow
description: Bốn chấm nhỏ dần đuổi theo con trỏ, mỗi chấm bám chậm hơn chấm trước nên tạo thành một vệt mềm phía sau.

moworks.author: moworks

options.lerps: share of the gap each dot closes per 60 fps frame

credit.author: Moworks Studio
credit.madeNote: the studio's own motion, written here

moworks.notes: 4 dots follow a cursor; every 60 fps frame dot k moves toward the cursor by 0.32 / 0.22 / 0.14 / 0.09 of the gap (iterate about 150 frames back from the current frame, interpolate the fraction, so it stays a function of time). Radii 10 / 8 / 6.4 / 5 px, opacity 1 / .78 / .58 / .42. Cursor visits (70,62) (252,70) (216,146) (90,138), each move 0.5 s power2.inOut every 0.75 s, 3 s loop. Real cursor drawn on top. Params: lerps ([0.32, 0.22, 0.14, 0.09]) · radii ([10, 8, 6.4, 5] px) · path [[x, y]] · move (0.5 s mỗi 0.75 s). Each frame iterates the chase from 150 frames back, so it stays a function of time.
moworks.titleVi: Chuỗi chấm đuổi theo con trỏ
